LESSON: WRITING 8.3.1 CREATIVE WRITING - SONGS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.3: Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing - Songs

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing - Songs. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we write an interesting song?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. compose a simple song related to the theme for effective communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 8.3.1 CREATIVE WRITING - SONGS
This lesson teaches Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing - Songs for Grade 8 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

STUDY STEPS
1. compose a simple song related to the theme for effective communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing - Songs using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing - Songs above.
2. Explain Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing - Songs to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing - Songs.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing - Songs with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing - Songs important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we write an interesting song?
2. Why is writing important for indigenous knowledge?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. compose a simple song related to the theme for effective communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
